VIP IS FREE FOR A LIMITED AMOUNT OF TIME!

Welcome to the NEXT GEN bowling game on Roblox! Featuring realistic pinsetters, amazing pin action, and beautiful alleys, this is unlike anything you'll see in any other bowling simulator.

Compete against your friends and explore different alleys! Purchase new bowling balls to upgrade your arsenal and different pin designs to spice up your lane!

Reminder: THIS GAME IS IN BETA! Expect bugs and frequent restarts, and make sure to use the bug reporter if you encounter any bugs.

We are not affiliated with any brand that may be present in our game. We do not take credit or endorse their logos in any of our works

A complete changelog and additional info can be found through the Roblox DevForum: 
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/bowling-paradise-changelog/442448
